ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low-intensity dominance; approximately 96:4 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary contiguous dark-field mapping across both lobes. Sparse high-intensity pixel distribution mapped as discrete localized clusters (spots) and unaligned vectors (streaks) concentrated on the left lobe and terminal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 112 degrees; depth is shallow relative to the overall vertical axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; the left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (saw-tooth pattern), while the right lobe exhibits lower-frequency, undulating wave patterns.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve profile extending from the median notch apex to the lateral terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) detected across the left lobe and concentrated at the lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white linear pixel disruptions detected; one prominent diagonal abrasion on the mid-left lobe and several smaller, horizontal segments on the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized pigmentary trauma including linear rake marks on the left lobe and circular scarring consistent with historical parasite or barnacle attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-intensity white spots located at the extreme distal coordinates of both the left and right fluke tips.
